glass_emission_strength.label: Glass glow
glass_emission_strength.help: Warm emissive brightness of translucent street-lamp glass

light_intensity.label: Lamp brightness
light_intensity.help: Point-light output from one glass chamber

firefly_chance.label: Firefly lamp chance
firefly_chance.help: Share of lamps with occasional fireflies

firefly_count.label: Fireflies near selected lamp

door_light_intensity.label: Door lantern brightness

door_light_radius.label: Door lantern reach

door_light_tilt_deg.label: Door lantern tilt
door_light_tilt_deg.help: Downward tilt of the door-lantern cone from horizontal

door_light_outer_cone_deg.label: Door lantern outer cone
door_light_outer_cone_deg.help: Cone half-angle; below 90 so the light stays on the street side of the wall

door_light_draw_m.label: Door lantern draw distance
door_light_draw_m.help: Door lights switch off beyond this distance from the camera

door_light_max_count.label: Door lantern count cap
door_light_max_count.help: Most door lanterns that become lights; any beyond keep the ordinary wall-lantern light

door_lantern_lit.label: Door lantern schedule
door_lantern_lit.help: always: door-lantern panes glow all day with their light; time-of-day: they follow the street-lamp schedule
